_help: Nova's Arcade, a giant hollow tree. wings = treehouse rooms (the first wing is the Trunk Hall inside the trunk; every later wing also grows a treehouse on a branch). Each wing has 'bays' numbered 1..N (odd = left wall, even = right wall). A game = {id, title, wing, bay, module, description, date_added, color, controls, controls_touch}; its code lives in games/<id>/game.js (see games/README.md). coming_soon = optional teaser titles for empty bays. Bays with nothing in them show as open 'coming soon' plinths. Run python3 build_data.py to validate.
name: Nova's Arcade
description: A giant hollow tree with an arcade inside. Every game here is one I built myself, and its branches grow a new treehouse room whenever I need space for more games.

games.title: Lorenz Crossing
games.description: Lorenz, dressed up as a frog, hops across glowing cellular-automaton blocks, comet lanes and a starry river to fill five golden nests. The middle block lane really runs Rule 90, and the cells inside every block evolve by Rule 90 too.
games.controls: Arrow keys or WASD to hop · P pause · M sound · Esc close
games.controls_touch: Swipe or use the pad · tap to hop forward

games.title: Honest Claw
games.description: A physics-only claw machine. The grip never weakens: prizes slip or stay based on contact, friction, shape and center of mass. Free play, no payout bank. Eight plushies: Mini Nova, Mini Lorenz, a turkey, a glider, a snowman, an acorn, a heart and a star.
games.controls: WASD or arrows to move · Space or Enter to drop · drag the pile to aim · P pause · M sound · Esc close
games.controls_touch: Drag to move the claw · use the stick · Drop to lower it

coming_soon.title: Rule 90 Painter
coming_soon.note: Tap cells to paint a Sierpinski triangle before time runs out.

coming_soon.title: Glider Builder
coming_soon.note: A Game of Life puzzle: build a glider that escapes the box.

coming_soon.title: Duckling Chase
coming_soon.note: Lead a line of ducklings across the pond.
